+import json
+from pathlib import Path
+
+import duckdb
+import matplotlib
+
+matplotlib.use("Agg")
+import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
+import numpy as np
+import pandas as pd
+
+
+OUT = Path("out")
+OUT.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
+
+df = duckdb.sql(
+    """
+    SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM crash_date)::INTEGER AS year,
+           SUM(number_of_motorist_killed)::INTEGER AS motorist_deaths,
+           SUM(number_of_cyclist_killed)::INTEGER AS cyclist_deaths
+    FROM read_parquet('data/crashes.parquet')
+    WHERE crash_date >= DATE '2013-01-01'
+      AND crash_date < DATE '2026-01-01'
+    GROUP BY year
+    ORDER BY year
+    """
+).df()
+assert df["year"].tolist() == list(range(2013, 2026))
+df["motorist_to_cyclist_ratio"] = df["motorist_deaths"] / df["cyclist_deaths"]
+
+years = df["year"].to_numpy()
+motorist = df["motorist_deaths"].to_numpy()
+cyclist = df["cyclist_deaths"].to_numpy()
+
+# Option 1: side-by-side annual counts.
+df[["year", "motorist_deaths", "cyclist_deaths"]].to_csv(
+    OUT / "values_1.csv", index=False
+)
+fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(11, 6.2), layout="constrained")
+x = np.arange(len(years))
+width = 0.38
+bars1 = ax.bar(x - width / 2, motorist, width, label="Motorists", color="#1769aa")
+bars2 = ax.bar(x + width / 2, cyclist, width, label="Cyclists", color="#f28e2b")
+ax.bar_label(bars1, padding=2, fontsize=8)
+ax.bar_label(bars2, padding=2, fontsize=8)
+ax.set_xticks(x, years, rotation=45)
+ax.set_ylabel("Deaths (people)")
+ax.set_title("NYC motorist and cyclist deaths by year, 2013–2025")
+ax.legend(frameon=False)
+ax.grid(axis="y", alpha=0.22)
+ax.set_axisbelow(True)
+fig.savefig(OUT / "option_1.png", dpi=180)
+plt.close(fig)
+
+# Option 2: annual-count trajectories emphasize change across years.
+df[["year", "motorist_deaths", "cyclist_deaths"]].to_csv(
+    OUT / "values_2.csv", index=False
+)
+fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(11, 6.2), layout="constrained")
+ax.plot(years, motorist, marker="o", linewidth=2.5, label="Motorists", color="#1769aa")
+ax.plot(years, cyclist, marker="o", linewidth=2.5, label="Cyclists", color="#f28e2b")
+ax.set_xticks(years, rotation=45)
+ax.set_ylabel("Deaths (people)")
+ax.set_title("Year-to-year trajectories of NYC motorist and cyclist deaths")
+ax.legend(frameon=False)
+ax.grid(alpha=0.22)
+fig.savefig(OUT / "option_2.png", dpi=180)
+plt.close(fig)
+
+# Option 3: ratio puts the relative magnitude on a single scale.
+df[["year", "motorist_deaths", "cyclist_deaths", "motorist_to_cyclist_ratio"]].to_csv(
+    OUT / "values_3.csv", index=False, float_format="%.4f"
+)
+fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(11, 6.2), layout="constrained")
+ratio = df["motorist_to_cyclist_ratio"].to_numpy()
+ax.plot(years, ratio, marker="o", linewidth=2.5, color="#5b4b8a")

+ax.set_xticks(years, rotation=45)
+ax.set_ylabel("Motorist deaths per cyclist death")
+ax.set_title("Annual motorist-to-cyclist death ratio in NYC, 2013–2025")
+ax.legend(frameon=False)
+ax.grid(axis="y", alpha=0.22)
+fig.savefig(OUT / "option_3.png", dpi=180)
+plt.close(fig)
